title: Victoria’s Secret & Co. Invites You to Listen to the Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call
summary: REYNOLDSBURG, Ohio, Aug. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- In conjunction with the Victoria’s Secret & Co. (NYSE: VSXY) second quarter 2026 earnings release, you are invited to listen to a live webcast of the conference call on Thursday, September 3 rd at 8:30 a.m. ET with Victoria’s Secret & Co.
